findings.claim: The global CleanUpService ticker in cleanup.go was changed from 10 minutes to 1 minute. As a result, all cleanup jobs (snapshots, query history, short URLs, temp users, annotations, etc.) run 10x as often, and the loop can run nearly continuously when a run takes longer than a minute.
The cleanup log statements include the full ids slice, which can contain thousands of annotation IDs and produce very large log lines.
The cleanup log statements log 'err' after the error has already been checked and returned, so the logged value is always nil.

coverage: pooled issues; severity and verdict are placeholders
